# Wendeline Okafor

Outreach coordinator for the network, based at Eastgate. Wendeline runs the [[Hearthside Visits|homebound service]], recruits and trains its volunteers, and keeps the list of patrons and their reading preferences.

She also manages the deposit collections at the two senior housing buildings and the county jail. Volunteers should contact her before changing a visit date, or if a patron seems unwell.
